formal_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ) (L : Submodule ℂ (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)), (∀ t ∈ L, MvPolynomial.eval (y + t) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0) → ∀ t ∈ L ⊔ Submodule.span ℂ {y}, MvPolynomial.eval (y + t) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0
plain_statement: If perm_m(y + t) = 0 for every t in a linear space L, the same holds for every t in L + span{y}. By homogeneity for 1 + c nonzero; at c = -1 the top coefficient of s -> perm(y + s l) is perm(l). First formal reduction under L-gct-036, requested by seat-gct-1.
title: Cone reduction: a linear space through a zero y inside the permanent hypersurface extends by the line of y
